description: Check whether ReplenishRadar fits a seller from a few facts about their business, and get a fit verdict. Reads no store data and needs none. Answers can be sent as fields or nested under answers; pass the returned attribution_token on a follow-up call to continue.

answers.description: The same answers as one object, instead of the fields above. Any other question from the public agent-intake survey may be included.

attribution_token.description: The token a previous call returned, to continue the same evaluation.

autonomy_intent.description: How much the agent will do: read only, prepare drafts, or act.

primary_pain.description: The inventory problem they most want solved.

sku_count_band.description: Roughly how many products they stock.

tier.description: Which question set these answers complete. Default A.

name: rr_evaluate_fit
